method: Six-second sequential measurements in an anonymous live Bilibili page, seeking to the same source segment in every window. Diagnostic ablations use the 1.7.8 controller and isolate the player-halo CSS blur. The exploratory GPU prototype is measured separately. The final 1.7.9 implementation is measured in public-page.json and verified with compositor pixels, fade masks, context loss and restoration.
limits: Variants are diagnostic and differ in rendering behavior. Exploratory prototype output did not carry the final fade-mask wiring. CPU submission timings exclude asynchronous GPU completion. System load and layout can vary across windows. The 308.4ms prototype-window interval is retained in the record.
